question: In September 2025, which state government approved an Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) policy to attract environment-friendly and low-polluting industries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kerala Government** approved a pioneering **Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG)** policy in **September 2025** to foster a sustainable industrial ecosystem.
 
• The main objective of this policy is to attract **environment-friendly** and **low-polluting industries** by providing a structured framework for **responsible investment**.
 
• This initiative aims to position **Kerala** as a global hub for **sustainable manufacturing** and **ethical business practices**, aligning with international standards.
 
• Under this policy, the state intends to offer various **incentives** and **fast-track clearances** to enterprises that demonstrate high compliance with **ESG criteria**.
 
• The policy is expected to benefit sectors such as **Information Technology (IT)**, **Biotechnology**, **Renewable Energy**, and **Value-added Agriculture**, which have a lower ecological footprint.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **ESG Framework:**
 
 
• **Environmental (E):** Focuses on how a company performs as a steward of nature, including **carbon emissions**, **waste management**, and **resource depletion**.
 
• **Social (S):** Examines how it manages relationships with **employees**, **suppliers**, **customers**, and the **communities** where it operates.
 
• **Governance (G):** Deals with a company’s **leadership**, **executive pay**, **audits**, **internal controls**, and **shareholder rights**.
 
 
 
• **Kerala’s Industrial Vision:**
 
 
• The state has been actively promoting **Private Industrial Parks** and **Campus Industrial Parks** to boost **employment** while maintaining its strict **ecological standards**.
 
• **Kerala** consistently ranks as a top performer in the **SDG India Index** published by **NITI Aayog**, reflecting its commitment to **Sustainable Development Goals**.
 
• The **Department of Industries and Commerce** is the nodal agency responsible for implementing these reforms to improve the **Ease of Doing Business (EoDB)**.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Modern **investors** and **multinational corporations** increasingly use **ESG scores** to evaluate the long-term **viability** and **risk profile** of their investments.
 
• By adopting an **ESG-centric policy**, **Kerala** joins an elite group of sub-national entities globally that prioritize **climate-resilient growth** over traditional industrial expansion.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The policy encourages the transition toward a **Circular Economy**, where **recycling** and **resource efficiency** are integrated into the core manufacturing process.
 
• It emphasizes **Carbon Neutrality**, supporting **Kerala's** target to become a **net-zero carbon emission state** by **2050**.
 
• Special focus is given to the **Social** aspect of the policy, ensuring **labor welfare**, **gender equality**, and **inclusive growth** within the industrial sector.
 
• Enterprises that adopt **clean energy** sources like **Solar** or **Wind power** are likely to receive additional **state-sponsored subsidies** under the new **ESG guidelines**.
